name: Renfield Shake Motor
description: 12V shake motor — 'the signature', Renfield's tremble. BTS7960 H-bridge on BCM GPIO: RPWM=27, LPWM=22, R_EN=17, L_EN=23. WIRING: run R_EN and L_EN to SEPARATE GPIO lines as listed — do NOT jumper them onto one pin. linear_actuator_control_v2.py claims each enable line independently with lgpio.gpio_claim_output, so a shared pin raises GPIO_BUSY (-79) on the second claim and every motor command fails at setup. All four lines are free on a bare node (no I2C 2/3, UART 14/15 or SPI 7-11 conflict), leaving the PCA9685 bus open for later parts. Common ground between the Pi and the BTS7960 logic side is required; the 12V motor supply must NOT share the Pi's 5V rail. Shake is a short burst: scenes run 900-2000ms at 50-80% and maxDuration caps any single energization at 5000ms.
